title: Sync Reporting Receipts Request
x-tool-summary: Record a consumer's independently verified reporting totals and destination evidence in the seller ledger.
description: Submit durable authenticated consumer reconciliation results for reporting materializations and post-official adjustments. This is a batched idempotent upsert, not an acknowledgement of mere webhook receipt. Identity comes from authenticated transport; the request MUST NOT assert a buyer or governance principal. After the caller loses account authority, its receipts for that account are refused like any other reference; a seller that permits reconciliation after a relationship ends keeps a reduced grant instead of revoking.

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated batch key. Exact retries reuse the key and body.

adjustment_receipts.description: Consumer acceptance or rejection of exact post-official adjustments.

x-adcp-validation.batch_identity: reporting_receipt_id values MUST be unique across receipts and adjustment_receipts, whose combined length MUST NOT exceed 100. Every referenced obligation, revision, materialization, and adjustment MUST resolve within the authenticated caller and account or fail with an indistinguishable unavailable result.
x-adcp-validation.after_revocation: Authority is never extended past its end. Once the caller's authority for the account ends, every reference to that account, including receipts for revisions it read earlier, resolves as unavailable, exactly like an unknown identifier. A seller that wants a buyer to finish reconciling after a relationship ends, for example after an agency change, keeps a reduced grant instead of revoking: an authorization whose allowed_tasks lists only the reconciliation tasks it permits, such as get_reporting_status, sync_reporting_receipts, and sync_reporting_status, with read_only false. Revocation, as in a fraud or compromise response, stops everything.
x-adcp-validation.partial_results: Each receipt is independent. One failed result does not roll back successfully recorded receipts; retries use the same receipt IDs and content.
